issues.summary: Enroll callback deletes all but newest TOTP without verifying a new factor was enrolled
issues.label: medium
issues.evidence: oidc-auth.service.ts:161-194 deletes every TOTP except the newest whenever state.enroll is true; nothing records the pre-existing set or checks that a new factor appeared, so a missing/misconfigured Action would delete a still-used device, despite the PR claiming it 'fails closed'.

issues.summary: No integration tests for the controller enroll branch, cleanup error swallowing, enroll validation, or the new authenticators route
issues.label: medium
issues.evidence: The diff changes no *.integration.spec.ts file; the controller branch at oidc-auth.controller.ts:228-236 and the GET oidc/mfa/authenticators route (guard, 403) have no coverage, so reverting them would not fail any test.

issues.summary: Cleanup failures are swallowed so the old authenticator may stay enrolled with no notice
issues.label: medium
issues.evidence: oidc-auth.controller.ts:228-236 catches any cleanup error, logs a warning and finishes login normally; the user/frontend is not told, so a lost device can stay enrolled even though the feature exists to remove it.

issues.summary: No test asserts ext-enroll-otp is added to the authorize URL
issues.label: medium
issues.evidence: auth0-api.service.ts:90-95 sets ext-enroll-otp when enroll is true; grepping the specs finds no assertion for it. If it regressed, the Action would not enroll a new factor but the callback would still delete TOTPs.

issues.summary: Unused entity schemas (OTP association, MFA enrollment session, OTP code) are dead code
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: Nothing in src references Auth0OtpAssociationSchema, MfaEnrollmentSessionSchema or OtpCodeSchema outside their own files. They look left over from an earlier MFA-API design.

issues.summary: Cached Management API token is not invalidated on 401/403
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: auth0-api.service.ts getManagementApiToken/fetchManagementApiToken never delete the cache entry on an auth error, so a token issued before scopes were granted stays in use until expires_in minus 60s. This is an edge case tied to deployment order.

issues.summary: Tenant-wide Management API token stored in plain text in shared Redis
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: auth0-api.service.ts:203-208 hSets the raw token under a global key. That matches the existing Firebase OAuth2 token pattern (cache.router.ts:267), so it is a design risk worth noting and not a clear defect.

issues.summary: Unlinked (SIWE) users get a 401 while Swagger documents only a 403
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: oidc-auth.service.ts:202-203 throws UnauthorizedException (401), but the controller documents only @ApiForbiddenResponse ('Not authenticated'), which is what AuthGuard returns when it gives false. This is a documentation mismatch.

issues.summary: enroll is documented as Boolean but only the literal 'true' is accepted
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: oidc-auth.controller.ts:99-117 uses @ApiQuery type Boolean, but the validator is z.literal('true').optional(), so ?enroll=false returns 400 even though the docs imply it is valid.

issues.summary: The authenticators endpoint's response has no Swagger type
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: Authenticator is a plain TS type (oidc-auth.service.ts:35-40) and @ApiOkResponse at controller.ts:262 has no type, so the OpenAPI output has no schema for the response. Most other @ApiOkResponse uses in the repo set a type.

issues.summary: AUTH.md does not document the enroll flow, new endpoint or Management API scope requirement
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: src/modules/auth/AUTH.md has no mention of enroll, authentication methods or Management API grants. The scope requirement exists only in a comment on fetchManagementApiToken.

issues.summary: Authentication-methods response is Zod-parsed in the API service, not the repository
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: auth0-api.service.ts:132 parses with Auth0AuthenticationMethodsSchema, while the existing token flow returns Raw<> and parses in auth0.repository.ts. That is inconsistent with the documented rule that repositories validate.

issues.summary: Route service and repository interface depend on datasource entity files
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: oidc-auth.service.ts:11 imports TOTP_AUTHENTICATION_METHOD_TYPE, and auth0.repository.interface.ts imports Auth0AuthenticationMethod, both from datasources/entities. That breaks the layering, though the cost is small.

issues.summary: getExtUserId does not use the shared getAuthenticatedUserIdOrFail helper
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: oidc-auth.service.ts:199 uses Number(authPayload.getUserId()). The route is behind AuthGuard with a verified JWT, so NaN is very unlikely, but the shared helper in assert-authenticated.utils.ts exists for exactly this.

issues.summary: Malformed created_at gives NaN and an arbitrary sort order
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: created_at is z.string().optional() (auth0-authentication-method.entity.ts), and Date.parse on a non-ISO string gives NaN, making the sort at oidc-auth.service.ts:184-187 unreliable. Auth0 returns ISO timestamps, so this is unlikely in practice.

issues.summary: created_at is cast with 'as string' after a separate .some() guard
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: oidc-auth.service.ts:178-186: the guard just before it makes the cast safe at runtime, so only type-narrowing style is at stake.

issues.summary: Superseded TOTPs are deleted one at a time
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: oidc-auth.service.ts:189-194 awaits each delete in turn. Usually only one method is deleted, and Promise.all would not prevent partial deletion either.

issues.summary: Token TTL buffer is hardcoded to 60s
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: auth0-api.service.ts:33 is a small safety margin subtracted from the provider's expires_in. Making it configurable has no concrete benefit.

issues.summary: Spec builds CacheDir('auth0_management_api_token','') by hand instead of using CacheRouter
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: auth0-api.service.spec.ts:147,190,196 (three places, not four) hardcode the key. Style/robustness preference.

issues.summary: Spec uses inline casts instead of userBuilder
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: oidc-auth.service.spec.ts:689 onward casts { extUserId } to the findOneOrFail return type. Test-style preference with no concrete defect.

issues.summary: Types section should move to a separate file
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: oidc-auth.service.ts:29-40 holds only two small types, so this is a preference.

issues.summary: Value used without validation
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: At auth0-api.service.ts:~201-208 the access_token and expires_in cached come from ManagementApiTokenResponseSchema.parse, so they are validated.

issues.summary: Caching may be unnecessary
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: Caching the client-credentials Management API token is standard (Auth0 rate-limits /oauth/token and tokens last hours); auth0-api.service.ts:201-208 caches it for expires_in minus 60s, which is clearly intended.

issues.summary: Unclear whether extUserId can be missing
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: oidc-auth.service.ts:202-204 explicitly throws when extUserId is missing, and cleanupSupersededAuthenticators returns early at line 163, so the case is handled.

issues.summary: Multiple instances may exist at the same time
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: controller.ts:267 is the stateless listAuthenticators handler, and the vague claim names no concrete concurrency or duplication problem the code shows.
